**Read the "What this is not" section of the README first.** Running Renovate, scheduling runs,
editing configuration, merging pull requests, triggering runs, and user accounts are permanent
exclusions. Requests for those are declined, and it is nothing to do with the quality of the idea.

changed a preset" is more useful than "add a preset column".
